snippet.title: What He Left | Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
3am. well 3:03 to be exact. someone is knocking on your door

through the peephole you only see a hood. theres no face

he wants to play a game. you step away from the door and he changes one thing in your apartment. find it and youre fine. dont find it and...

free on itch.io october 16

my first game. 7 nights, 5 endings, about 1h

streamers go for it, no need to ask. send me the link tho

tiktok / x @romanoorm

#indiehorror #horrorgame #itchio
